editions.title: Didache — Lightfoot English transcription
editions.classification: Early Christian teaching text / church order
editions.canonScope: Historical text, separate from this app’s 66-book Bible baseline. No universal canon claim.
editions.authorship: Anonymous text traditionally titled Teaching of the Twelve Apostles; the title alone does not establish apostolic authorship.
editions.dating: Nineteenth-century English translation. Wikisource catalogs 1891 while the pinned page also carries an 1889 category; the exact digital revision is identified below. Ancient composition dates are not resolved by this import.
editions.survival: All 16 chapters present in the pinned digital transcription; no claim that every ancient form or ending survives.
editions.attribution: Didache, translated by J. B. Lightfoot. Transcription by Wikisource contributors, revision 14637905. HTML removed and whitespace normalized; wording and source numbering retained.
editions.license: Underlying translation: public domain. Wikisource transcription contributions: CC BY-SA 4.0 where applicable.

rightsEvidence.label: Pinned source and public-domain notice
rightsEvidence.note: Source identifies this Lightfoot translation as public domain and retains a CC BY-SA 4.0 footer for contributor text.

rightsEvidence.label: Translator’s dates
rightsEvidence.note: The source library records Lightfoot as 1828–1889 and lists the 1891 Apostolic Fathers abridgment.

rightsEvidence.label: EU copyright term, Article 1
rightsEvidence.note: Life plus 70 years; Lightfoot died in 1889. The imported historical translation is beyond that term.

rightsEvidence.label: Wikisource contributor history
rightsEvidence.note: Attribution for transcription contributors. Share-alike terms are retained for any copyrightable transcription contribution.

editions.transcriptionStatus: Source-derived import, not independently proofread against a print scan. Source unit numbering is preserved; no Scripture or historical text was generated.
